text:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #5231 is blocked by CI. Only failing on linux-integration/shard-12 and windows-smoke. Failure looks nondeterministic (timeout/kv eviction). Can someone take a look or kick a targeted rerun? Merge window closes at 18:00 PST.

jordan: I saw something similar on a different PR last week — probably the kv cache eviction timing. If a rerun passes we can merge.

sam: @maya I can rebase and push a tiny timing tweak (add a 10ms backoff) if that helps, but would prefer a targeted rerun first to confirm flakiness.

maya: Yeah let's rerun first. ops-oncall do we have capacity to run a targeted rerun for pr=5231 on shard-12 + windows-smoke? :eyes:

ops-oncall: @maya scheduling targeted rerun now — queued on linux-integration/shard-12 and windows-smoke. ETA ~2m.

ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued: PR 5231 -> linux-integration/shard-12, windows-smoke. Command: /rerun targeted --pr 5231 --shards linux-integration/shard-12,windows-smoke

buildkite: Build #7642 (PR 5231) - linux-integration/shard-12 - STARTED

buildkite: Build #7643 (PR 5231) - windows-smoke - STARTED

buildkite: Build #7642 - linux-integration/shard-12 - FAILED
maya: Ugh — linux shard still failed, same assertion. Pasting minimal snippet from logs:
```
E test_eviction_order.rs:47: assert_eq!(evicted, expected_sequence)
left: ["a","c"]
right: ["a","b","c"]
```

jordan: That's odd — left missing "b" like it wasn't enqueued. Could be a race with the eviction background job. Sam, still want to rebase+timing?

sam: I'll push a rebase with a 10ms backoff and small test retry (2 attempts) in a minute. If that doesn't fix it, we should file a flaky-test ticket and skip on mac/windows until root cause.

ops-oncall: Build #7643 - windows-smoke - PASSED

ci-bot: New push detected on PR 5231 by sam -> scheduling CI (full matrix)

buildkite: Build #7650 (PR 5231) - linux-integration/shard-12 - STARTED

buildkite: Build #7650 - linux-integration/shard-12 - PASSED

maya: Nice — linux shard passed after the small backoff. @jordan can you give the second approval so we can merge before the window closes?

jordan: Taking a quick look at the diff... code change is tiny and test retry/backoff is fine. Approving now. :+1:

maya: Thanks both. Merging after one more green is safe.

ci-bot: Merge check: all required approvals present, CI green across required shards. Merging PR 5231 to main.

maya: Merge complete. I'll open a follow-up issue to track if eviction races pop up again (reference: #5231). Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:
